messages.subject: Errors in occurrence query
messages.body_plain:
I've encountered troubles when querying gbif with the Occurrence data component of Wallace, more specifically the module using occCite. The progress bar freezes:

and after a while I'm met with this message in the R Studio console:

I've also noted that occCite fails to find occurrences for some taxa.
One example would be Celtis occidentalis L., which has me stumped. I suspect it might be because it's not the top result when searching for that taxa, but rather the one with Tuthill as author, which lacks registered occurrences.

Are these known bugs? Is there a solution or workaround? Would they be ameliorated if there were options to add additional specs, such as delimiters and taxa author?

messages.subject: Re: Errors in occurrence query
messages.body_plain:
Hi Simon,
I'l take a look into how to extend Wallace to be able to select beyond the top choice and adding additional specs (as wee have added the option to choose only entries with uncertainty information).
Wallace can't operate with a dataset that has the same species but with different names, it will register this as two different species (Celtis occidentalis and Celtis occidentalis L., for example).
My suggested workaround would be to download directly from GBIF and then clean it up (make the species names identical and arrange the first three columns to be scientific_name, longitude, and latitude) to use that file in the User Specified module.

-Bethany

messages.subject: Announcement: wallace v2 publication in Early View!
messages.subject_clean: Announcement: wallace v2 publication in Early View!
messages.body_plain:
Exciting news from the Wallace Team!

Our software note in Ecography announcing the release of version 2 and its advancements since the initial release of Wallace is available for Early View!
http://doi.org/10.1111/ecog.06547

Installing Wallace V2
v2 is on CRAN and can be installed using:
install.packages("wallace")
library(wallace)
run_wallace()

A vignette for using this version is found here: Wallace v2 Vignette <https://wallaceecomod.github.io/wallace/articles/tutorial-v2.html>

If you wish to continue to use v1, see the instructions below...
Instruction for installing previous versions of Wallace (v1)
If you want to install the previous version of Wallace (v1), you have three options to install it in your machine.
Install from CRAN using the following line of code:
remotes::install_version("wallace", version = "1.1.3", repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")
Install from Github using the following line of code:
remotes::install_github("wallaceecomod/wal...@v1.1.3")
Install the v1 docker image. Please see the “Docker Image and Tools for Cloud Implementations” section for more information.
Thanks for your continued support & bug testing.
Happy Modeling!
- Bethany & the Wallace Team
